hero-title.title:
WEB DESIGN THAT CLICKS
FUNCTIONAL & BUILT TO PERFORM

hero-subtitle.paragraph: Dubai's custom web design studio — we blend strategy and technology to create fast, smart websites for UAE businesses. Your professional website design company, built to perform.

style.hero-highlight-1: flex-direction: row; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 0;
style.hero-highlight-1-dot: width: 18px; height: 18px; border-radius: 50%; background-color: var(--hl-green); flex-shrink: 0;
style.hero-highlight-1-text: font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 15px; font-weight: 500; line-height: normal; color: var(--hl-ink); white-space: nowrap; @media(--mobile) { font-size: 14px; }

style.hero-card-responsive: position: absolute; left: -40px; top: 110px; z-index: 2; flex-direction: row; align-items: center; gap: 14px; padding: 16px 22px 16px 18px; background-color: #ffffff; border: 1.5px solid #0e2a25; border-radius: 18px; box-shadow: 5px 5px 0px #0e2a25; @media(--tablet) { left: -16px; top: 60px; } @media(--mobile) { position: relative; left: auto; right: auto; top: auto; align-self: stretch; padding: 12px 16px; }
style.hero-card-responsive-icon: width: 44px; height: 44px; border-radius: 12px; background-color: var(--hl-amber); flex-shrink: 0;
style.hero-card-responsive-text: flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: 2px; padding: 0;
style.hero-card-responsive-title: font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; line-height: normal; color: var(--hl-ink); white-space: nowrap; @media(--mobile) { white-space: normal; font-size: 15px; }
style.hero-card-responsive-sub: font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 400; line-height: normal; color: #56665f;
style.hero-card-seo: position: absolute; right: -44px; top: 420px; z-index: 2; flex-direction: row; align-items: center; gap: 14px; padding: 16px 22px 16px 18px; background-color: #ffffff; border: 1.5px solid #0e2a25; border-radius: 18px; box-shadow: 5px 5px 0px #0e2a25; @media(--tablet) { right: -16px; top: 300px; } @media(--mobile) { position: relative; left: auto; right: auto; top: auto; align-self: stretch; padding: 12px 16px; }
style.hero-card-seo-icon: width: 44px; height: 44px; border-radius: 12px; background-color: var(--hl-coral); flex-shrink: 0;
style.hero-card-seo-text: flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: 2px; padding: 0;
style.hero-card-seo-title: font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; line-height: normal; color: var(--hl-ink); white-space: nowrap; @media(--mobile) { white-space: normal; font-size: 15px; }
style.hero-card-seo-sub: font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 400; line-height: normal; color: #56665f;
style.hero-section: width: 100%; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 32px; padding: 96px 120px 90px 120px; background-color: var(--hl-cream); @media(--tablet) { padding: 72px 40px 70px 40px; gap: 28px; } @media(--mobile) { padding: 48px 16px 56px 16px; gap: 24px; }
style.hero-stickers: flex-direction: row; align-items: center; padding: 6px 0; gap: 0px; @media(--mobile) { flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: center; row-gap: 10px; }
style.hero-sticker-studio: font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 17px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 1.02px; line-height: normal; text-transform: uppercase; border: 1.5px solid #0e2a25; border-radius: 4px; padding: 8px 14px; box-shadow: 3px 3px 0px #0e2a25; white-space: nowrap; background-color: var(--hl-amber); color: var(--hl-ink); transform: rotate(3deg); position: relative; z-index: 1; @media(--mobile) { font-size: 14px; }
style.hero-sticker-location: font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 17px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 1.02px; line-height: normal; text-transform: uppercase; border: 1.5px solid #0e2a25; border-radius: 4px; padding: 8px 14px; box-shadow: 3px 3px 0px #0e2a25; white-space: nowrap; background-color: var(--hl-green); color: var(--hl-cream); transform: rotate(-2deg); margin-left: -6px; @media(--mobile) { font-size: 14px; }
style.hero-title: font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 104px; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1; text-align: center; color: var(--hl-green); text-transform: uppercase; & span { color: var(--hl-coral); } @media(--tablet) { font-size: 76px; } @media(--mobile) { font-size: 48px; line-height: 1.05; }
style.hero-subtitle: font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 20px; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.55; color: #56665f; text-align: center; max-width: 720px; @media(--tablet) { font-size: 18px; } @media(--mobile) { font-size: 16px; }
style.hero-ctas: flex-direction: row; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: center; gap: 16px; padding: 0 0 7px 0; flex-wrap: wrap;
style.hero-cta-packages: font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; line-height: normal; color: var(--hl-ink); border: 1.5px solid #0e2a25; border-radius: 100px; padding: 15px 28px; box-shadow: 3px 3px 0px #0e2a25; white-space: nowrap; transition: transform 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s; &:hover { transform: translate(2px, 2px); box-shadow: 1px 1px 0px #0e2a25; } @media(--mobile) { font-size: 15px; padding: 13px 22px; } background-color: var(--hl-amber);
style.hero-cta-work: font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; line-height: normal; color: var(--hl-ink); border: 1.5px solid #0e2a25; border-radius: 100px; padding: 15px 28px; box-shadow: 3px 3px 0px #0e2a25; white-space: nowrap; transition: transform 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s; &:hover { transform: translate(2px, 2px); box-shadow: 1px 1px 0px #0e2a25; } @media(--mobile) { font-size: 15px; padding: 13px 22px; } background-color: var(--hl-cream);
style.hero-highlights: flex-direction: row; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 28px; padding: 0; flex-wrap: wrap; @media(--mobile) { gap: 12px; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; }
style.hero-visual: position: relative; width: 100%; max-width: 1200px; flex-direction: column; gap: 16px; padding: 40px 0 20px 0; @media(--mobile) { padding: 16px 0 0 0; }
style.hero-mockup-image: display: block; width: 100%; height: 560px; object-fit: cover; border: 2px solid #0e2a25; border-radius: 28px; box-shadow: 10px 10px 0px #0e2a25; background-color: #f3f3f3; @media(--tablet) { height: 420px; } @media(--mobile) { height: 240px; border-radius: 18px; box-shadow: 6px 6px 0px #0e2a25; }
